title: Self-Correction-Monoculture: do all models share the same self-correction blind spot?

original_idea.body: Joint self-correction failure structure across 6-10 models; does cross-model checking escape it (arXiv:2507.02778, arXiv:2502.04313).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: shared self-correction blind spots undermine model-reviews-model oversight.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reuse probe set + record self-correction + joint-failure structure.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on a small probe set across 6-10 models.

novelty.reasoning: Shared structure of self-correction failure mostly unexplored.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Homogeneity of self-correction blind spots mostly unexplored.
